dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward a sharply defined posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance on the right lateral side with a transition to cool-toned shadows on the left side of the dorsal ridge.
